kind: author component publication verification; no new tests, witness runs, independent QA or review
testProviders: repository fake readiness CLI; no live provider CLI tested

formatter.scope: rendered README only; all sealed raw bytes preserved

integrationPrerequisite: Containing packet root .gitattributes preserves the corrections subtree raw bytes and sets rendered README.md to LF; no nested attributes file added.
selectionLimits: Omitted unrelated owner state and directory names, source report narrative, scratch/dependency checkouts and full generated absolute-path inputs/configs.
Selected all baseline/fixed entry edges, held/repaired in-flight and disposable timeout pairs, and final mutation outcomes. Intermediate-source and repeated runs remain only in the full source seal.
Full Vitest JSON retained for entry and mutation cases. In-flight/timeout status/errors remain in exact raw receipts and event/controller records; full stack JSON is omitted there.
Historical harness retained for inspection with author-owned checkout paths; not asserted portable or re-executed.
Private provider transcripts, independent QA and publication actions are outside this component.
sealPolicy: Component SHA256SUMS.txt covers every component file except itself. Its final hash is reported separately to avoid circular hashing.
